record.paper_title: Research Problems on Relations Between Nijenhuis Geometry and Integrable Systems
record.original_question: What is the interpretation of the space K(V) in terms of abstract curvature tensors under the identification between quadratic Killing tensors and curvature-type algebraic tensors?

evidence.quote: Q10 ... it would be interesting to see an interpretation of K(V ) in terms of abstract curvature tensors.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional real vector space equipped with a non-degenerate symmetric bilinear form $g$. A quadratic Killing tensor on the flat model space $(V,g)$ is a symmetric $(0,2)$-tensor field on $V$ whose components, in any affine coordinate system, are quadratic polynomials and which satisfies the Killing equation
$$\nabla_{(i} K_{jk)} = 0,$$
where $\nabla$ is the flat Levi-Civita connection of $g$ and parentheses denote symmetrization. Let $K(V)$ denote the vector space of all such quadratic Killing tensors on $(V,g)$.

There is a classical linear identification between $K(V)$ and the space of "algebraic curvature tensors" on $V$, i.e. tensors $R \in \bigotimes^4 V^*$ satisfying the symmetries of a Riemann curvature tensor:
$$R_{ijkl} = -R_{jikl} = -R_{ijlk} = R_{klij}, \qquad R_{i[jkl]} = 0.$$

Under this identification, give an intrinsic interpretation of the subspace $K(V)$ (and any natural distinguished subspaces of it determined by integrability or Nijenhuis-type conditions) purely in terms of abstract algebraic curvature tensors on $V$. In particular, characterize which algebraic curvature tensors correspond to Killing tensors satisfying the Nijenhuis integrability conditions.
artifact.category_tag: Killing tensors and algebraic curvature tensors
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a research problem on the interpretation of the space of quadratic Killing tensors as abstract curvature tensors in the Nijenhuis-geometry framework. While related work translates Nijenhuis integrability conditions for Killing tensors into algebraic conditions on the corresponding algebraic curvature tensor (e.g., Schöbel's "Nijenhuis Integrability for Killing Tensors", arXiv:1502.07516, and earlier algebraic-integrability work on constant sectional curvature manifolds), no source found directly provides a complete intrinsic curvature-tensor interpretation of K(V) as requested. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Nijenhuis Integrability for Killing Tensors
status_evidence.snippet: Translates Nijenhuis integrability conditions for second-order Killing tensors into algebraic conditions on the associated algebraic curvature tensor.
status_evidence.claim: Related (partial) results exist linking Killing-tensor integrability to algebraic curvature-tensor conditions, but a full interpretation of K(V) is not established.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic integrability conditions for Killing tensors on constant sectional curvature manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Provides algebraic integrability conditions for Killing tensors via the corresponding algebraic curvature tensor.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier work gives algebraic conditions on curvature-type tensors corresponding to integrable Killing tensors but does not fully interpret the whole space K(V).
